vb_textbox.text: If there is a pattern I did not seem to recognise it. There are 4 gnomes, two with longer pointed heads (purple and brown), and two with flatter heads (red and grey). I tended to have more luck with picking the purple one frequently, however through out the tasks the amount of mushrooms can fluctuate and there are times where purple will not be the right one to pick. The grey gnome tended to be the one with the worst returns. The key thing to remember is that the game fluctuates, almost like it realises that you have figured out which gnome is the best. Therefore spamming the same gnome may in fact cause the game to change up how frequently you get that gnome. Good Luck!
